lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for specific kinds of changes, as no category yet has at least two tests that agree after noise correction.
Predictions were mostly too high in early rounds compared to measured, noise-corrected results.
Predictions in Round 3 were too low, underestimating winning changes such as sign-in hints and path selection copy.
Changes resulting in no clear effect must be treated as having no effect, even when noise-corrected estimates lean positive.

candidates.title: Two Column Pick Friend Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pet selection screen into a dynamic two-column layout separating preset styles from custom attribute options.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion in the funnel at 60.9% and a long median duration of 89s; support emails also report custom pet generation failures.

guard.reason: The redesign maintains the pick_friend screen's job of letting the user select a pet.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop (39.1%) and support reports failures; redesigns show moderate positive lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Check Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated confirmation step after home intro to verify the pet is visible on desktop and explain basic click-drag placement.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints about pets not showing on desktop and users being confused on how to control or interact with their companion.

new_desktop_check.headline: Is Your Companion Visible on Screen?
new_desktop_check.body: Your pet should now be floating on your desktop. Click and drag to place them anywhere.

guard.reason: Adding a new confirmation screen after home_intro is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens tends to increase drop-off, historically yielding negative lift (-3.3%).

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Behavior Preview Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive behavior preview component to the waiting screen, allowing users to test pet animations while generation runs.
candidates.why: The home wait step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s; engaging users during generation prevents drop-off before completion.

components.text: Preview desktop pet behaviors while waiting

guard.reason: Adding interactive previews during generation on the waiting screen is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: New interactive flows require high effort and past test showed negligible effect (+0.3%).

candidates.title: Spotlight Desktop Controls Intro
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro screen into a spotlight layout that highlights key interaction shortcuts like right-clicking to manage or hide the pet.
candidates.why: Support received emails regarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to pets post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Master Desktop Pet Controls
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet anytime to hide them, open controls, or start a chat.

guard.reason: Redesigned home_intro layout retains its purpose and stays within onboarding scope.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off (35.2%) and direct support complaints; inline redesign avoids extra screen penalty.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Recovery Hint
candidates.change: Displays an explicit hint reassuring users that signing in with their existing account restores all previously adopted companions.
candidates.why: The top support complaint (8 emails) concerns pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Log in with your existing account to instantly restore your saved pets and progress.

guard.reason: Adding a helpful sign-in hint does not violate any onboarding or fairness rules.

candidates.score_note: Top support issue (8 emails); sign-in hints have proven positive results across multiple tests.

candidates.title: Generation Time Remaining Counter
candidates.change: Enables time estimation displays and active progress indicators on the waiting screen during pet creation.
candidates.why: Home step waiting time has a high mean (2336s) and median (201s), causing users to abandon before finishing.

guard.reason: Displaying progress and estimated wait time during an actual waiting process is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high wait time duration; wait info toggles/indicators consistently deliver positive lift.

candidates.title: Custom Creation Path Perk Banner
candidates.change: Adds a highlighted badge explaining the advantages of custom generation versus default companion presets.
candidates.why: The choose_path step median time is only 8s; setting expectations early helps users pick the path best suited for them.

components.text: Custom path lets you personalize color palettes and traits

guard.reason: Adding an informative badge to choose_path retains both options and mentions no pricing.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path has low drop-off; incentive banners previously showed minimal impact (+0.4%).

candidates.title: Companion Origin Story Headline Update
candidates.change: Updates the story screen headline and button text to clearly introduce the desktop pet concept before path selection.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on the choose_path step is high (514s), indicating some users hesitate at the entry point of onboarding.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience

guard.reason: Updating text on the story screen preserves its job of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Low cost text update addressing hesitation; copy updates on path selection showed strong positive lift (+4.6%).

candidates.title: Background Ready Desktop Sound Alert
candidates.change: Adds a sound alert toggle and ready notification setup on the waiting screen so users know when generation completes in the background.
candidates.why: Long wait times (median 201s) mean users minimize the app; notification options ensure they return to finish onboarding.

components.label: Play chime when companion is ready

guard.reason: Adding background sound alert options to the waiting screen is an allowed modification.

candidates.score_note: Helps re-engage users minimizing app during wait; notification changes show reliable moderate lift.

candidates.title: Interactive Naming Certificate Checklist
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a checklist layout where users confirm their pet's name, personality, and desktop settings.
candidates.why: Adoption stage is the biggest bottleneck in conversion (60.9%); a clear checklist layout structured step-by-step increases completion confidence.

adoption_certificate.headline: Finalize Your Companion's Adoption Record
adoption_certificate.body: Confirm your companion's name and floating desktop behavior before completion.

guard.reason: Replacing the adoption certificate with a settings checklist loses the required official stamp adoption representation.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for most kinds of change, as few categories have at least two tests that agree after noise correction.
Home new_flow changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Choose_path copy, home wait_info, and sign_in hint changes have produced winning tests, though outcomes vary by specific test.
Predictions in early rounds were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results.
Predictions in Round 3 were too low, underestimating winning changes such as sign-in hints and path selection copy.
Tests with no clear effect must be treated as having no effect, even when noise-corrected estimates lean positive.
